title: A failed test collection is recorded as 0 tests and passes the NAC-04 check in capture-baselines --phase before
severity_rationale: S4, equal to the estimate: reachable only in a mode that has finished.

evidence.note: the comparison treats a collection error as a count of 0
the false pass exists only in --phase before, which is complete; --phase after loads committed counts

sibling_sites_checked: The after mode loads the committed pre-rail counts, so a failed collection fails NAC-04 there.
recommendation: Fix if the tool is reused for another baseline: a collection error should fail the check.
